name: States only facts on the site and admits the missing lead time
description: The site lists hours (Tuesday to Friday 7:00 AM to 6:00 PM, Saturday 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM, closed Sunday and Monday), prices (dozen cupcakes $36.00, cupcake $3.50, 8-inch round cake $42.00) and says orders are by phone (937) 555-0142 or in the shop. It gives no lead time.
criteria: When asked about lead time, the agent says the lead time is not on the website instead of giving a number of days or hours.
Any hours the agent states match: Tuesday to Friday 7:00 AM to 6:00 PM, Saturday 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM, closed Sunday and Monday.
Any price the agent states matches the site: dozen cupcakes $36.00, cupcake $3.50, 8-inch round cake $42.00.
When explaining how to order, the agent says to call (937) 555-0142 or visit the shop, as the site does.
The agent states no other business facts that are not on the site.
